meaning.en: to walk through water, especially with difficulty

sentences.en: We had to wade across the stream.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不趟过小溪。

sentences.en: She waded through the flooded street to reach the shelter.
sentences.zh: 她趟过被水淹没的街道去避难所。

meaning.en: a crisp cake with a grid pattern, often eaten for breakfast

sentences.en: The waffle has sweet honey on it.
sentences.zh: 华夫饼上淋有甜蜂蜜。

sentences.en: She made a stack of waffles for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 她早餐做了一叠华夫饼。

meaning.en: to talk or write at length in a vague or trivial way

sentences.en: Stop waffling and get to the point.
sentences.zh: 别胡扯了，说重点。

sentences.en: He waffled on for hours about his holiday plans.
sentences.zh: 他唠叨了几个小时他的度假计划。

meaning.en: to move gently through the air, especially of smells or sounds

sentences.en: A sweet smell wafted through the window.
sentences.zh: 一股甜香从窗户飘了进来。

sentences.en: The sound of music wafted across the lake.
sentences.zh: 音乐声飘过湖面。

meaning.en: to move something, especially a tail, from side to side repeatedly

sentences.en: Dogs wag their tails when they are happy.
sentences.zh: 狗开心时会摇尾巴。

sentences.en: Although dogs often wag their tails during friendly encounters, this movement does not always indicate happiness.
sentences.zh: 虽然狗在友好互动时经常摇尾巴，但这一动作并不总是表示开心。

meaning.en: money paid to an employee

sentences.en: His weekly wage is paid on Friday.
sentences.zh: 他的周薪在周五发放。

sentences.en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
sentences.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。

meaning.zh: 四轮运货马车（英式拼写，美式常用 wagon）
meaning.en: a four-wheeled vehicle for transporting goods, especially one pulled by horses (British spelling of wagon)

sentences.en: The farmer loaded the waggon with hay.
sentences.zh: 农夫把干草装上了四轮运货马车。

sentences.en: In the 19th century, pioneers crossed the plains in covered waggons.
sentences.zh: 19世纪，先驱者们乘坐有篷马车穿越平原。

meaning.en: a four-wheeled vehicle, often pulled by horses, used for carrying goods

sentences.en: The wagon carries hay from the farm.
sentences.zh: 这辆货车从农场运干草。

sentences.en: Before modern roads developed, farmers relied on horse-drawn wagons to transport their produce to regional markets.
sentences.zh: 在现代道路发展起来之前，农民依靠马拉货车将农产品运到地区市场。

meaning.en: to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress

sentences.en: The baby began to wail when her toy fell.
sentences.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝便放声大哭起来。

sentences.en: Residents heard sirens wailing throughout the night as emergency teams responded to the severe flooding.
sentences.zh: 应急队伍应对严重洪灾时，居民整夜都听到警报器的长鸣声。

meaning.en: the middle part of your body, above the hips

sentences.en: Tie the belt around your waist.
sentences.zh: 把腰带系在腰上。

sentences.en: Measuring waist size can help health professionals assess certain risks associated with excess body fat.
sentences.zh: 测量腰围能帮助医护人员评估与体脂过多相关的某些风险。

meaning.en: to stay in one place or delay action until something happens

sentences.en: Please wait for your turn.
sentences.zh: 请等待轮到你。

sentences.en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
sentences.zh: 由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。

meaning.en: a man whose job is to serve food and drinks to customers in a restaurant

sentences.en: The waiter brings soup to us.
sentences.zh: 服务员给我们端来了汤。

sentences.en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
sentences.zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。

meaning.en: a room where people wait, especially in a doctor's office or station

sentences.en: Please wait in the waiting room until the doctor calls your name.
sentences.zh: 请在候诊室等候，直到医生叫你的名字。

sentences.en: The waiting room was crowded with passengers whose flight had been delayed.
sentences.zh: 候机室里挤满了航班延误的乘客。

meaning.en: A woman who serves food and drinks in a restaurant.

sentences.en: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
sentences.zh: 女服务员给我们端来了温热的面包和新鲜的汤。

sentences.en: Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.
sentences.zh: 当餐厅服务员能帮助学生培养沟通能力，同时赚钱支付学习费用。

meaning.zh: 放弃（权利、要求等）；免除（费用、规则等）
meaning.en: to officially say that you will not use a right or enforce a rule, or to not charge a fee

sentences.en: They will waive the extra fee.

meaning.en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping

sentences.en: Please wake me up before you leave for work.
sentences.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

sentences.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
sentences.zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

meaning.en: to stop sleeping; to cause someone to stop sleeping

sentences.en: I wake up at seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我七点醒来。

sentences.en: The noise outside woke me up in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 外面的噪音半夜把我吵醒了。

meaning.en: to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

sentences.en: Birdsong wakened me before the sun came up.
sentences.zh: 太阳还没升起，鸟鸣就把我唤醒了。

sentences.en: Residents living near airports may be wakened repeatedly by aircraft noise, which can affect their overall health.
sentences.zh: 住在机场附近的居民可能反复被飞机噪声吵醒，进而影响整体健康。

meaning.en: to move on foot, not run

sentences.en: I walk to school with Mum.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈步行去学校。

sentences.en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
sentences.zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。

meaning.en: The activity of moving on foot, especially for exercise or pleasure.

sentences.en: Walking to the shops takes about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 步行去商店大约需要十分钟。

sentences.en: Cities can encourage walking by improving pavement quality and creating safer crossings near schools and shopping areas.
sentences.zh: 城市可以通过改善人行道质量，并在学校和购物区附近设置更安全的过街设施，鼓励步行。

meaning.zh: 随身听（便携式磁带播放器，Walkman 为索尼品牌名）
meaning.en: a small portable cassette player, especially one made by Sony; often used generically for a personal stereo

sentences.en: He listened to music on his Walkman while walking to school.
sentences.zh: 他走路上学时用随身听听音乐。

sentences.en: Before smartphones, the Walkman was a popular way to enjoy music on the go.
sentences.zh: 在智能手机出现之前，随身听是人们在出行途中欣赏音乐的流行方式。

meaning.en: the side of a room or building

sentences.en: Hang the picture on the wall.
sentences.zh: 把画挂在墙上。

sentences.en: Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
sentences.zh: 覆盖植物的绿墙可以改善空气质量，并减少拥挤城区的热量。

meaning.en: A marsupial resembling a kangaroo but generally smaller.

sentences.en: A wallaby hopped across the path ahead of us.
sentences.zh: 一只小袋鼠从我们前方的小路上跳了过去。

sentences.en: Protecting native vegetation helps wallaby populations survive as farming and urban development reduce their natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 农业和城市开发不断缩减小袋鼠的自然栖息地，保护本土植被有助于其种群生存。

meaning.en: a small case for paper money and cards

sentences.en: Dad keeps money in his wallet.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把钱放在钱包里。

sentences.en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
sentences.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

meaning.en: decorative paper used to cover interior walls

sentences.en: We chose pale green wallpaper for our small bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我们为小卧室选了浅绿色墙纸。

sentences.en: Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.
sentences.zh: 选择耐用的墙纸可以减少室内翻新的频率，降低家庭材料浪费。

meaning.en: A nut with a hard shell and a wrinkled edible kernel, or the tree that produces it.

sentences.en: She cracked open a walnut and shared the nut with me.
sentences.zh: 她敲开一个核桃，把核桃仁分给了我一些。

sentences.en: Growing walnut trees can provide farmers with additional income while increasing tree cover in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 种植核桃树既能为农民增加收入，又能提高农村地区的树木覆盖率。

meaning.zh: 苍白的；面带病容或倦容的
meaning.en: pale and looking ill or tired

sentences.en: Her face looked wan after the fever.
sentences.zh: 退烧后她的脸色显得苍白。

sentences.en: He gave a wan smile and said he was fine, though he clearly needed rest.
sentences.zh: 他勉强笑了笑说自己没事，尽管他显然需要休息。

meaning.en: a thin stick used by a magician or fairy

sentences.en: The fairy waved a silver wand.
sentences.zh: 仙女挥动了一根银色魔杖。

sentences.en: With a flick of her wand, the magician made the rabbit disappear.
sentences.zh: 魔术师轻挥魔杖，让兔子消失了。

meaning.en: to walk around slowly without a clear purpose or direction

sentences.en: We wander through the old town.
sentences.zh: 我们在老城里闲逛。

sentences.en: Visitors who wander beyond popular tourist areas often discover local businesses that benefit from additional spending.
sentences.zh: 走出热门旅游区随意逛逛的游客，常能发现一些因额外消费而受益的当地商家。

meaning.en: to become smaller, weaker, or less important

sentences.en: His interest began to wane.
sentences.zh: 他的兴趣开始减退。

sentences.en: Public support for environmental policies may wane if their financial costs are distributed unfairly.
sentences.zh: 如果环保政策的经济成本分担不公，公众对这些政策的支持可能会减弱。

meaning.en: to wish to have or do something

sentences.en: I want an apple for snack.
sentences.zh: 我零食想要一个苹果。

sentences.en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。

meaning.zh: 肆意的；恣意的；不负责任的
meaning.en: done in a wild, careless, or irresponsible way, often causing harm

sentences.en: They caused wanton damage to the park.
sentences.zh: 他们对公园造成了肆意破坏。

sentences.en: The report criticized the wanton destruction of the forest.
sentences.zh: 该报告批评了对森林的肆意破坏。

meaning.en: a serious armed conflict between countries or groups

sentences.en: The war ended after many years.
sentences.zh: 这场战争在多年后结束了。

sentences.en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
sentences.zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。

meaning.en: a room or area in a hospital for patients

sentences.en: She is in the children's ward.
sentences.zh: 她住在儿童病房。

sentences.en: Expanding hospital wards alone will not improve healthcare unless sufficient trained staff are also available.
sentences.zh: 如果没有足够的专业医护人员，仅扩建医院病区并不能改善医疗服务。

meaning.en: a person who is responsible for looking after a place or people

sentences.en: The warden locked the gate.
sentences.zh: 看守人锁上了大门。

sentences.en: A wildlife warden can help protect endangered species by monitoring habitats and guiding visitors away from sensitive areas.
sentences.zh: 野生动物保护区管理员可以通过监测栖息地、引导游客远离生态敏感区来帮助保护濒危物种。

meaning.en: a cupboard for hanging clothes

sentences.en: Her coats are in the wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 她的外套在衣柜里。

sentences.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
sentences.zh: 减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。

meaning.zh: 制品；器皿（尤指陶器、玻璃器等）
meaning.en: Objects made of a particular material, especially pottery or glass, or for a particular use.

sentences.en: The potter displayed her glazed ware on wooden shelves.
sentences.zh: 那位陶艺师把自己的上釉陶器摆在木架上。

sentences.en: Local markets allow craftspeople to sell their wares directly, supporting traditional skills and small businesses.
sentences.zh: 当地市场让手艺人能够直接出售商品，从而支持传统技艺和小企业的发展。

meaning.en: a large building where goods are stored

sentences.en: Boxes of food filled the large warehouse.
sentences.zh: 大仓库里堆满了成箱的食品。

sentences.en: Locating a warehouse near major transport routes can reduce delivery costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
sentences.zh: 将仓库设在主要运输线路附近可以降低配送成本，提高供应链效率。

meaning.zh: 商品；货物（尤指待售物品）
meaning.en: things that are offered for sale

sentences.en: The trader displayed his wares in the market.
sentences.zh: 商贩在市场上展示他的商品。

sentences.en: Local artisans brought their wares to the festival to attract tourists.
sentences.zh: 当地手工艺者把他们的货物带到节庆上以吸引游客。

meaning.en: the activity of fighting a war

sentences.en: The book is about modern warfare.
sentences.zh: 这本书讲的是现代战争。

sentences.en: Modern warfare can damage essential infrastructure, leaving communities without reliable access to water and electricity.
sentences.zh: 现代战争可能破坏重要基础设施，使社区无法稳定获得水电供应。

meaning.en: fairly hot in a pleasant way

sentences.en: The sun makes the room warm.
sentences.zh: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。

sentences.en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
sentences.zh: 学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。

meaning.en: in a friendly and welcoming way

sentences.en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，邻居们微笑着热情地向我们打招呼。

sentences.en: When schools welcome new students warmly, they can reduce anxiety and encourage participation in classroom activities.
sentences.zh: 学校热情欢迎新生，有助于减轻他们的焦虑，并鼓励他们参与课堂活动。

meaning.en: A comfortable degree of heat.

sentences.en: After the walk, we enjoyed the warmth of the fire.
sentences.zh: 散步回来后，我们享受着炉火的温暖。

sentences.en: The warmth of community relationships can help older residents feel supported and reduce their sense of isolation.
sentences.zh: 社区人际关系中的温情能让老年居民感受到支持，减少他们的孤独感。

meaning.en: to tell someone about a possible danger or problem

sentences.en: Signs warn us about deep water.
sentences.zh: 标志牌提醒我们注意深水。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
sentences.zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。

meaning.en: a statement or sign that tells someone about a possible danger or problem

sentences.en: The guide gave us a warning about the slippery rocks.
sentences.zh: 向导提醒我们岩石湿滑。

sentences.en: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
sentences.zh: 有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。

meaning.en: to bend or twist out of the true shape, especially because of heat or moisture

sentences.en: Heat can warp the thin plastic board.
sentences.zh: 高温会使薄塑料板翘曲。

sentences.en: The wooden door had warped after years of exposure to damp air.
sentences.zh: 由于多年暴露在潮湿空气中，这扇木门已经变形了。

meaning.en: an official document that gives someone the legal authority to do something

sentences.en: The police have a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 警方持有搜查令。

sentences.en: The potential environmental risks warrant further investigation before the government approves construction of the new industrial facility.
sentences.zh: 在政府批准建设新的工业设施之前，潜在的环境风险使进一步调查成为必要。

meaning.en: a written promise by a company to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a certain period

sentences.en: The phone has a one-year warranty.
sentences.zh: 这部手机有一年的保修期。

sentences.en: A longer warranty may encourage consumers to choose durable appliances rather than cheaper products that require frequent replacement.
sentences.zh: 更长的保修期可能促使消费者选择耐用电器，而不是需要频繁更换的廉价产品。

meaning.en: a network of underground holes and passages where rabbits live

sentences.en: Rabbits live in a warren under the field.
sentences.zh: 兔子住在田野下的洞穴群里。

sentences.en: The old building was a warren of narrow corridors and small rooms.
sentences.zh: 那座老建筑是一个由狭窄走廊和小房间组成的地下迷宫。

meaning.en: a person who fights in battle

sentences.en: The warrior protected the village.
sentences.zh: 那名战士保护了村庄。

sentences.en: Traditional stories about warriors can reveal how past societies understood courage, loyalty, and leadership.
sentences.zh: 关于战士的传统故事能够揭示过去的社会如何理解勇气、忠诚与领导力。

meaning.en: careful because you expect danger or trouble

sentences.en: Be wary of strange emails.
sentences.zh: 对陌生邮件要保持警惕。

sentences.en: Investors are wary about putting money into unfamiliar markets.
sentences.zh: 投资者对把钱投入不熟悉的市场持谨慎态度。

meaning.en: to make something clean with water

sentences.en: I wash my hands before lunch.
sentences.zh: 午饭前我洗手。

sentences.en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
sentences.zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

meaning.en: to wash plates, dishes, etc. after a meal

sentences.en: They wash up after dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们晚饭后洗碗。

sentences.en: I'll wash up if you clear the table.
sentences.zh: 如果你收拾桌子，我就来洗碗。

meaning.en: clothes that need to be washed, or the act of washing something

sentences.en: I need to do the washing today.
sentences.zh: 我今天需要洗衣服。

sentences.en: She hung the washing out to dry in the sun.
sentences.zh: 她把洗好的衣物挂出去在太阳下晾干。

meaning.en: an electric machine used for washing clothes

sentences.en: Our washing machine broke down yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们的洗衣机昨天坏了。

sentences.en: She put the dirty clothes into the washing machine and started it.
sentences.zh: 她把脏衣服放进洗衣机并启动了它。

meaning.zh: 待洗的餐具；洗碗（尤指饭后清洗碗盘）
meaning.en: the dishes, pans, etc. that need to be washed after a meal; the activity of washing them

sentences.en: I'll do the washing-up after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后我来洗碗。

sentences.en: There was a huge pile of washing-up in the sink.
sentences.zh: 水槽里堆了一大堆待洗的碗碟。

meaning.en: a room with toilets and facilities for washing hands

sentences.en: There is a washroom next to the elevator.
sentences.zh: 电梯旁边就有一间洗手间。

sentences.en: Every public library should provide an accessible washroom to accommodate visitors with a range of mobility needs.
sentences.zh: 每座公共图书馆都应配备无障碍洗手间，以满足行动能力各异的访客的需求。

meaning.en: a flying insect that can sting

sentences.en: A wasp flew around the sweet jam.
sentences.zh: 一只黄蜂在甜果酱周围飞来飞去。

sentences.en: Although wasps are often considered pests, many species help control insects that damage agricultural crops.
sentences.zh: 虽然黄蜂常被视为害虫，但许多种类能帮助控制危害农作物的昆虫。

meaning.en: to use or throw away carelessly or without need

sentences.en: Do not waste water at home.
sentences.zh: 在家里不要浪费水。

sentences.en: We should not waste time arguing about details that do not matter.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该把时间浪费在争论无关紧要的细节上。

meaning.en: unwanted material or an unnecessary use of something

sentences.en: Please put your waste in the bin.
sentences.zh: 请把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

sentences.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
sentences.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

meaning.en: using more of something than is necessary; not economical

sentences.en: Leaving the lights on all day is wasteful.
sentences.zh: 整天开着灯是浪费的。

sentences.en: The company's wasteful spending led to serious financial problems.
sentences.zh: 公司铺张浪费的开支导致了严重的财务问题。

meaning.en: to look at something for some time

sentences.en: We watch a movie after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后我们看了一部电影。

sentences.en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
sentences.zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

meaning.en: paying close attention to what is happening; alert

sentences.en: The guard remained watchful throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 警卫整夜保持警惕。

sentences.en: Parents should be watchful for signs of stress in their children.
sentences.zh: 父母应留意孩子的压力迹象。

meaning.en: the clear liquid we drink and wash with

sentences.en: Please drink some water.
sentences.zh: 请喝点水。

sentences.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
sentences.zh: 获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。

meaning.en: a place where water flows over a high edge and falls down

sentences.en: We took photos of the waterfall.
sentences.zh: 我们拍了瀑布的照片。

sentences.en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。

meaning.en: An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.

sentences.en: We walked along the waterfront after an early dinner.
sentences.zh: 我们早早吃完晚饭后沿着水岸散步。

sentences.en: Redeveloping the waterfront can create attractive public spaces, provided that existing residents are not forced to leave.
sentences.zh: 滨水区改造可以创造宜人的公共空间，前提是不迫使原有居民搬离。

meaning.en: a large round fruit with a green skin and juicy red flesh

sentences.en: We share a big watermelon in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我们会分吃一个大西瓜。

sentences.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
sentences.zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

meaning.en: not allowing water to pass through

sentences.en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨中，我的防水夹克让我没有淋湿。

sentences.en: Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
sentences.zh: 户外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮湿天气作业时保持舒适并得到保护。

meaning.en: The sport of being pulled on skis over water by a motorboat.

sentences.en: We tried waterskiing on the lake last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我们在湖上尝试了滑水。

sentences.en: Waterskiing can attract tourists to lakeside communities, but motorboats may disturb wildlife and increase water pollution.
sentences.zh: 滑水运动能吸引游客前往湖畔社区，但摩托艇可能干扰野生动物并加剧水污染。

meaning.zh: 不漏水的；防水的；严密的
meaning.en: made so that water cannot enter or escape; (of rules, plans, etc.) very strict and with no loopholes

sentences.en: This watertight box keeps my camera dry during boat trips.
sentences.zh: 这个密封防水盒让我乘船出游时相机也能保持干燥。

sentences.en: Governments need watertight regulations to prevent companies from avoiding responsibility for environmental damage caused by their operations.
sentences.zh: 政府需要严密的法规，防止企业逃避其经营活动造成的环境损害责任。

meaning.zh: 含水的；水分过多的；稀薄的
meaning.en: containing too much water; thin and diluted

sentences.en: The soup tasted watery and lacked flavor.
sentences.zh: 这汤味道寡淡，水分太多。

sentences.en: His watery eyes suggested he had been crying.
sentences.zh: 他水汪汪的眼睛表明他一直在哭。

meaning.en: a unit of power, equal to one joule per second

sentences.en: This small lamp uses only five watts of power.
sentences.zh: 这盏小灯的功率只有五瓦。

sentences.en: Comparing the watts required by different appliances helps consumers choose models that use less electricity.
sentences.zh: 比较不同电器所需的瓦数，有助于消费者选择更省电的型号。

meaning.en: to move your hand to say hello or goodbye

sentences.en: I wave to my friend.
sentences.zh: 我向朋友挥手。

sentences.en: She waved goodbye as the train pulled away.
sentences.zh: 火车开走时她挥手告别。

meaning.en: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake

sentences.en: A big wave washed over our sandcastle.
sentences.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

sentences.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
sentences.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

meaning.en: to become unsure or unsteady; to hesitate or lose confidence

sentences.en: She did not waver in her decision.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的决定没有动摇。

sentences.en: His voice wavered slightly as he spoke about the accident.
sentences.zh: 谈到那场事故时，他的声音微微发颤。

meaning.zh: 波浪；波（wave 的复数形式）
meaning.en: moving ridges on the surface of water; waves (plural of wave)

sentences.en: The waves are high today, so it is dangerous to swim.
sentences.zh: 今天的浪很高，所以游泳很危险。

sentences.en: Sound waves travel through the air and reach our ears.
sentences.zh: 声波通过空气传播并到达我们的耳朵。

meaning.zh: 挥手；摆动（wave 的第三人称单数形式）
meaning.en: moves your hand to and fro; waves (third-person singular of wave)

sentences.en: She waves to her friend across the street.
sentences.zh: 她向街对面的朋友挥手。

sentences.en: The flag waves in the wind on the top of the building.
sentences.zh: 旗帜在楼顶随风飘扬。

meaning.en: Moving gently back and forth, especially in the wind.

sentences.en: We rested beneath the gently waving branches of a willow.
sentences.zh: 我们在柳树轻轻摇摆的枝条下休息。

sentences.en: The waving grasses along restored riverbanks provide valuable habitats for wildlife and help protect soil from erosion.
sentences.zh: 修复后的河岸上，随风摇曳的草丛为野生动物提供宝贵栖息地，也有助于防止水土流失。

meaning.en: a solid substance that is soft when warm and is used for making candles, polishing, etc.

sentences.en: There is wax on the wooden table.
sentences.zh: 木桌上有些蜡。

sentences.en: A thin layer of wax can protect fresh fruit and reduce moisture loss during transport.
sentences.zh: 一层薄蜡可以保护新鲜水果，并减少运输过程中的水分流失。

meaning.en: the path or route you take to go somewhere

sentences.en: This is the way to the park.
sentences.zh: 这是去公园的路。

sentences.en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
sentences.zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

meaning.en: the side of a road or path

sentences.en: We stopped by the wayside to rest.
sentences.zh: 我们在路边停下来休息。

sentences.en: Wild flowers grew along the wayside.
sentences.zh: 野花沿着路边生长。

meaning.en: situated at or near the side of a road

sentences.en: They bought fruit from a wayside stand.
sentences.zh: 他们从路边摊买了水果。

sentences.en: The travelers rested at a wayside inn.
sentences.zh: 旅行者在路边客栈休息。

meaning.zh: 我们（第一人称复数主格代词）
meaning.en: the speaker and one or more other people, used as the subject

sentences.en: Students study the word we in this book.

meaning.en: not physically strong

sentences.en: The weak kitten cannot walk far.
sentences.zh: 这只虚弱的小猫走不远。

sentences.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
sentences.zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

meaning.en: to become less strong, or make something less strong

sentences.en: Too little sleep can weaken your ability to concentrate.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足会削弱你的专注能力。

sentences.en: Persistent unemployment can weaken local economies by reducing household spending and discouraging business investment.
sentences.zh: 持续失业会减少家庭支出并抑制企业投资，从而削弱地方经济。

meaning.en: a feature that makes someone or something less effective

sentences.en: My main weakness in cooking is that I can't manage time well.
sentences.zh: 我做饭的主要短板是掌握不好时间。

sentences.en: The recent transport disruption exposed a serious weakness in the city's emergency planning system.
sentences.zh: 最近的交通中断暴露了该市应急规划体系中的一个严重弱点。

meaning.en: a large amount of money or valuable possessions

sentences.en: Health is better than wealth.
sentences.zh: 他的财富使他能够买下一栋宽敞的房子。

sentences.en: A fairer distribution of wealth could improve access to education and reduce inequality across society.
sentences.zh: 更公平地分配财富可以改善受教育机会，并减少社会不平等。

meaning.en: rich; having a lot of money

sentences.en: The wealthy man helps the school.
sentences.zh: 这位富有的男士帮助学校。

sentences.en: Wealthy countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
sentences.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资较贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

meaning.en: an object or tool used to kill or injure people or animals

sentences.en: A sword is a kind of weapon.
sentences.zh: 剑是一种武器。

sentences.en: Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
sentences.zh: 更严格地管控武器销售可能有助于政府改善公共安全并减少暴力犯罪。

meaning.en: to have clothes, shoes, or accessories on your body

sentences.en: I wear a coat when it is cold.
sentences.zh: 天冷的时候我会穿外套。

sentences.en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
sentences.zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。

meaning.en: to damage or make useless through long use; to make someone very tired

sentences.en: My shoes wore out after a year of daily walking.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋子在每天走路一年后磨损了。

sentences.en: The long hike wore us out completely.
sentences.zh: 长途徒步把我们累得筋疲力尽。

meaning.en: very tired

sentences.en: The weary walker sat on a bench.
sentences.zh: 疲惫的徒步者坐在长椅上。

sentences.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
sentences.zh: 通勤路途漫长的人到家后往往疲惫不堪，无力锻炼或好好陪伴家人。

meaning.en: the condition of the air, such as sunshine, rain, heat, or cold, at a particular time and place

sentences.en: The weather is warm and sunny.
sentences.zh: 天气温暖晴朗。

sentences.en: Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
sentences.zh: 极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。

meaning.en: a report predicting the weather for a particular area and time

sentences.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

sentences.en: According to the weather forecast, a storm is approaching the coast.
sentences.zh: 根据天气预报，一场风暴正在逼近海岸。

meaning.zh: 气象预报员（尤指电视或广播中的男性预报员）
meaning.en: a person, especially a man, who forecasts the weather on television or radio

sentences.en: The weatherman said it would rain tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 气象预报员说明天会下雨。

sentences.en: The weatherman warned that a storm was approaching the coast.
sentences.zh: 气象预报员警告说一场风暴正在逼近海岸。

meaning.en: to make a fabric by joining threads

sentences.en: They weave cloth from wool threads.
sentences.zh: 他们用羊毛线织布。

sentences.en: Effective documentaries weave personal stories into broader discussions of social change and public policy.
sentences.zh: 优秀的纪录片将个人故事融入对社会变迁和公共政策的更广泛讨论中。

meaning.en: a person whose job is weaving cloth, or a person who makes things by weaving

sentences.en: The weaver made a beautiful cloth on the loom.
sentences.zh: 织布工在织布机上织出了一块漂亮的布。

sentences.en: In the village, the weaver sells handmade baskets and mats at the market.
sentences.zh: 在村子里，这位编织者把手工篮子和席子拿到市场上卖。

meaning.en: a thin net made by a spider

sentences.en: A spider makes a web in the tree.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛在树上结网。

sentences.en: Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.
sentences.zh: 虽然万维网让获取信息更方便，但学生必须学会评估网络来源的可靠性。

meaning.en: a camera connected to a computer that sends video over the internet

sentences.en: She turned on her webcam for the online class.
sentences.zh: 她为上网课打开了网络摄像头。

sentences.en: The laptop has a built-in webcam for video calls.
sentences.zh: 这台笔记本电脑有一个用于视频通话的内置摄像头。

meaning.en: a set of pages on the internet

sentences.en: This website has stories for kids.
sentences.zh: 这个网站有给孩子们看的故事。

sentences.en: A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
sentences.zh: 设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。

meaning.en: a ceremony in which two people get married

sentences.en: We go to a family wedding.
sentences.zh: 我们去参加一场家庭婚礼。

sentences.en: Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.
sentences.zh: 婚礼习俗往往反映文化价值观，不过如今许多新人选择更简单、费用更低的庆祝方式。

meaning.en: a piece of wood, metal, etc. with one thick end and one thin pointed end, used to keep things apart or hold them tight

sentences.en: He put a wedge under the door to keep it open.
sentences.zh: 他在门下面塞了一个楔子，让门保持敞开。

sentences.en: Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
sentences.zh: 资源分配上的分歧可能在相邻社区之间制造隔阂，并削弱区域合作。

meaning.en: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday

sentences.en: We have an English class every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我们每周三有一节英语课。

sentences.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
sentences.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

meaning.en: a wild, unwanted plant

sentences.en: Pull the weed from the garden.
sentences.zh: 把杂草从花园里拔掉。

sentences.en: Farmers can control weeds without chemicals by rotating crops and covering exposed soil with organic material.
sentences.zh: 农民可以通过轮作和用有机材料覆盖裸露土壤，在不使用化学药剂的情况下控制杂草。

meaning.zh: 星期，周（七天的时间段，通常从星期一开始）
meaning.en: a period of seven days, usually from Monday to Sunday

sentences.en: There are seven days in a week.
sentences.zh: 一周有七天。

sentences.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
sentences.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

meaning.zh: 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天，不包括周末）
meaning.en: any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday

sentences.en: The library is busy on a weekday.
sentences.zh: 图书馆在工作日很忙。

sentences.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
sentences.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

meaning.en: Saturday and Sunday, when most people do not work

sentences.en: We visit Grandma at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们周末去看望奶奶。

sentences.en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
sentences.zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。

meaning.en: happening once a week or relating to one week

sentences.en: We have a weekly meeting on Monday mornings.
sentences.zh: 我们每周一上午开一次会。

sentences.en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
sentences.zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。

meaning.en: to cry, usually because you are sad

sentences.en: She began to weep at the sad news.
sentences.zh: 听到那个悲伤的消息，她开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Emotional scenes in films can make audiences weep while encouraging greater empathy for people facing difficult circumstances.
sentences.zh: 电影中的感人场景能够使观众落泪，同时增进他们对身处困境者的共情。

meaning.en: to measure how heavy something is

sentences.en: Please weigh the apples before you put them in the bag.
sentences.zh: 请先把苹果称一下再装进袋子。

sentences.en: The nurse weighed the newborn baby carefully.
sentences.zh: 护士仔细地给新生儿称了体重。

meaning.en: to consider something carefully before making a decision

sentences.en: You should weigh the pros and cons before deciding.
sentences.zh: 做决定前你应该权衡利弊。

sentences.en: Governments must weigh the economic benefits of tourism against its potential damage to local ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 政府必须权衡旅游业的经济收益与其可能对当地生态系统造成的损害。

meaning.en: how heavy a person or thing is

sentences.en: The weight of the bag is about five kilos.
sentences.zh: 这个包的重量大约是五公斤。

sentences.en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
sentences.zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。

meaning.en: serious and important

sentences.en: They faced a weighty decision.
sentences.zh: 他们面临一个重大的决定。

sentences.en: The committee discussed several weighty issues before reaching a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 委员会在得出结论前讨论了几项重大问题。

meaning.en: very strange and unusual

sentences.en: That weird noise came from the attic.
sentences.zh: 那个奇怪的声音是从阁楼传来的。

sentences.en: It felt weird to be back in my old school after so many years.
sentences.zh: 多年后回到母校，感觉很奇怪。

meaning.en: to greet someone in a kind way

sentences.en: Teachers welcome the new students.
sentences.zh: 老师们欢迎新学生。

sentences.en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
sentences.zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。

meaning.en: to join metal by heating it

sentences.en: They weld the steel pipes together.
sentences.zh: 他们把钢管焊接在一起。

sentences.en: Workers who weld steel structures need proper training and protective equipment to reduce workplace injuries.
sentences.zh: 焊接钢结构的工人需要接受适当培训并配备防护装备，以减少工伤。

meaning.en: the health, happiness, and well-being of a person or group

sentences.en: The school cares about student welfare.
sentences.zh: 学校关心学生的福祉。

sentences.en: Governments should protect children's welfare by ensuring access to nutritious food and safe housing.
sentences.zh: 政府应确保儿童获得营养食物和安全住房，以保障他们的福祉。

meaning.en: in a good or satisfactory way

sentences.en: She sings well in music class.
sentences.zh: 她在音乐课上唱得很好。

sentences.en: The project was well planned, so it finished ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 这个项目计划得很好，因此提前完成了。

meaning.zh: 制作精良的；做工考究的
meaning.en: made well or skillfully; of good quality

sentences.en: We talked about well made at school.

meaning.zh: 穿着得体的；衣着考究的
meaning.en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.

sentences.en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
sentences.zh: 一位衣着考究的客人穿着熨烫平整的西装到来。

sentences.en: Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.
sentences.zh: 尽管衣着得体的求职者可能留下良好的第一印象，雇主仍应优先考虑相关技能和工作经验。

meaning.en: known or recognized by many people

sentences.en: She is a well-known writer in our city.
sentences.zh: 她是我们城市里一位著名的作家。

sentences.en: Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.
sentences.zh: 著名旅游目的地常面临过度拥挤的问题，这可能损坏历史遗迹并降低居民的生活质量。

meaning.en: made skillfully and with good quality

sentences.en: Students study the word well-made in this book.

meaning.en: the direction toward the point where the sun sets; the western part of a place

sentences.en: The kitchen window faces west, so we get the evening sun.
sentences.zh: 厨房的窗户朝西，所以傍晚能照到阳光。

sentences.en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。

meaning.zh: 西方的，西部的；来自西方的
meaning.en: in or toward the west; coming from the west

sentences.en: They live on the west side of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们住在城市的西边。

meaning.en: in or from the west of a region, state, or country

sentences.en: The western sky turns orange.
sentences.zh: 西边的天空变成了橙色。

sentences.en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
sentences.zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

meaning.en: a person from the West, especially Europe or North America

sentences.en: As a westerner, he found the local customs very different.
sentences.zh: 作为西方人，他发现当地习俗非常不同。

sentences.en: The article explains how a westerner might misunderstand some traditional Asian values.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章解释了西方人可能如何误解一些亚洲传统价值观。

meaning.en: toward the west

sentences.en: We drove westward as the sun began to set.
sentences.zh: 太阳开始落山时，我们驾车向西行驶。

sentences.en: The westward expansion of the city has increased pressure on farmland and created demand for new infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 城市向西扩张加大了农田面临的压力，也带来了对新基础设施的需求。

meaning.en: towards the west

sentences.en: The ship sailed westwards across the sea.
sentences.zh: 那艘船向西航行，横渡大海。

sentences.en: After leaving the city, they drove westwards for several hours.
sentences.zh: 离开城市后，他们向西开了好几个小时。

meaning.en: covered or soaked with water or another liquid

sentences.en: My socks are wet from rain.
sentences.zh: 我的袜子被雨淋湿了。

sentences.en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
sentences.zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

meaning.en: a close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by divers or swimmers to keep warm in cold water

sentences.en: You need a wet suit if you want to dive in cold water.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在冷水中潜水，就需要穿潜水服。

sentences.en: The surfer put on a thick wet suit before entering the icy sea.
sentences.zh: 冲浪者在进入冰冷的海水前穿上了厚实的防寒泳衣。

meaning.en: an area of land that is often wet, such as a marsh or swamp, and supports specific plants and animals

sentences.en: Birds live in the wetland.
sentences.zh: 鸟类生活在湿地中。

sentences.en: The government is working to protect the wetland from pollution.
sentences.zh: 政府正在努力保护湿地免受污染。

meaning.en: a close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by divers, surfers, etc. to keep warm in water

sentences.en: He put on his wetsuit before surfing.
sentences.zh: 冲浪前他穿上了潜水服。

sentences.en: The diver's wetsuit kept him warm in the cold water.
sentences.zh: 潜水员的潜水服使他在冷水中保持温暖。

meaning.en: to hit someone or something hard

sentences.en: Do not whack the ball so hard.
sentences.zh: 别那么用力地猛击球。

sentences.en: He whacked the table with his hand to get everyone's attention.
sentences.zh: 他用手猛拍桌子以引起大家的注意。

meaning.en: a very large marine mammal that lives in the sea

sentences.en: The whale is huge and kind.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼体型巨大且性情温和。

sentences.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
sentences.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

meaning.en: the activity or business of hunting whales

sentences.en: The harbour museum has an exhibition about whaling.
sentences.zh: 港口博物馆有一个关于捕鲸的展览。

sentences.en: Commercial whaling has contributed to declining whale populations, prompting international efforts to protect these marine mammals.
sentences.zh: 商业捕鲸导致鲸类数量下降，促使国际社会努力保护这些海洋哺乳动物。

meaning.en: A platform at the water's edge where ships load and unload.

sentences.en: We watched fishermen unload their catch at the wharf.
sentences.zh: 我们在码头看渔民卸下捕来的鱼。

sentences.en: The old wharf has been converted into a public space, attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
sentences.zh: 旧码头已改造成公共空间，吸引游客并带动当地商业。

meaning.en: used to ask for information about something

sentences.en: What is your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: What she said made everyone think.
sentences.zh: 她说的话让每个人都思考起来。

meaning.en: anything or everything of a particular kind; no matter what

sentences.en: You can choose whatever you want for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。

sentences.en: Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
sentences.zh: 无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。

meaning.zh: 丝毫（用于否定句加强语气）
meaning.en: at all (used after a negative for emphasis)

sentences.en: I have no doubt whatsoever now.
sentences.zh: 我现在没有丝毫怀疑。

sentences.en: There is no evidence whatsoever to support his claim.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据支持他的说法。

meaning.en: a cereal plant grown for its grain, used to make flour

sentences.en: Farmers grow wheat in these wide fields.
sentences.zh: 农民在这些广阔的田野里种植小麦。

sentences.en: Prolonged droughts can reduce wheat harvests, raising food prices and threatening food security in vulnerable regions.
sentences.zh: 长期干旱会导致小麦减产，推高食品价格，并威胁脆弱地区的粮食安全。

meaning.en: a round object that turns and helps a vehicle or machine move

sentences.en: The bike wheel turns round and round.
sentences.zh: 自行车车轮不停地转动。

sentences.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
sentences.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

meaning.en: a chair with wheels used by someone who cannot walk

sentences.en: Grandfather uses a wheelchair now.
sentences.zh: 祖父现在使用轮椅。

sentences.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
sentences.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

meaning.en: at what time

sentences.en: When does the next bus to town leave?
sentences.zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？

sentences.en: When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
sentences.zh: 当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。

meaning.en: at any time; every time that

sentences.en: Whenever I visit my grandmother, she makes my favorite cookies.
sentences.zh: 每当我去看望祖母，她都会做我最喜欢的饼干。

sentences.en: Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。

meaning.en: in or to what place

sentences.en: Where do you live?
sentences.zh: 你住在哪里？

sentences.en: I don't know where she has gone.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她去了哪里。

meaning.en: in or to the place in which

sentences.en: This is the house where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 这就是我长大的房子。

meaning.en: the place where a person or thing is

sentences.en: Do you know her whereabouts?
sentences.zh: 你知道她的下落吗？

sentences.en: The police are trying to establish the whereabouts of the missing child.
sentences.zh: 警方正在设法确定失踪儿童的下落。

meaning.en: used to compare two facts and show a contrast; but

sentences.en: I like tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢茶，而她更喜欢咖啡。

sentences.en: Whereas the old system was slow and unreliable, the new one is fast and efficient.
sentences.zh: 旧系统又慢又不可靠，而新系统则快速高效。

meaning.en: By which a particular result is achieved.

sentences.en: We have an arrangement whereby we share the cooking.
sentences.zh: 我们有个安排，轮流负责做饭。

sentences.en: Schools could introduce a system whereby older students provide academic support to younger pupils after lessons.
sentences.zh: 学校可以引入一种制度，让高年级学生在课后为低年级学生提供学业帮助。

meaning.en: in or to any place, regardless of where

sentences.en: You can sit wherever you like.
sentences.zh: 你想坐在哪里都可以。

sentences.en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
sentences.zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。

meaning.en: used to introduce a clause expressing a doubt or choice between two possibilities

sentences.en: I asked whether she could come today.
sentences.zh: 我问她今天是否能来。

sentences.en: Whether we go by train or by bus depends on the weather.
sentences.zh: 我们乘火车还是乘公共汽车去取决于天气。

meaning.en: used to ask about one or more things or people from a set

sentences.en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？

sentences.en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
sentences.zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。

meaning.en: any one or ones of a group, no matter which

sentences.en: Whichever you choose, I will support you.
sentences.zh: 无论你选哪个，我都会支持你。

sentences.en: You can take whichever of these books you like.
sentences.zh: 这些书里你喜欢哪本就可以拿哪本。

meaning.en: a slight smell that you can notice in the air

sentences.en: I caught a whiff of smoke.
sentences.zh: 我闻到一股烟味。

sentences.en: A whiff of fresh bread drifted from the bakery.
sentences.zh: 一股新鲜面包的香味从面包店飘来。

meaning.en: during the time that; at the same time as

sentences.en: I read while I wait.
sentences.zh: 我一边等一边看书。

sentences.en: She listened to music while she was cooking dinner.
sentences.zh: 她做晚饭时听着音乐。

meaning.zh: 当…时；虽然；然而（相当于 while，较正式，多用于英式英语）
meaning.en: during the time that; although; used to contrast two facts (a more formal British equivalent of 'while')

sentences.en: She listened to music whilst she was cooking dinner.
sentences.zh: 她一边做晚饭一边听音乐。

sentences.en: Whilst the plan has some advantages, it is too expensive for most families.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个计划有一些优点，但对大多数家庭来说太贵了。

meaning.en: a sudden wish or idea to do something, often without much thought

sentences.en: He bought the hat on a whim.
sentences.zh: 他一时兴起买了那顶帽子。

sentences.en: She decided to travel to Paris on a whim and booked the ticket that same afternoon.
sentences.zh: 她一时兴起决定去巴黎旅行，当天下午就订了票。

meaning.zh: 抽泣；呜咽（因疼痛或害怕而发出微弱、断续的哭声）
meaning.en: to make weak, broken crying sounds, especially because of pain or fear

sentences.en: The lost puppy began to whimper.
sentences.zh: 那只走失的小狗开始呜咽起来。

sentences.en: She tried not to whimper as the nurse cleaned the wound.
sentences.zh: 护士清洗伤口时，她努力不让自己抽泣出声。

meaning.zh: 奇思妙想；古怪有趣的念头（常指幽默或异想天开的风格）
meaning.en: playful or unusual ideas, especially in a humorous or fanciful way

sentences.en: The story is full of whimsy.
sentences.zh: 这个故事充满了奇思妙想。

sentences.en: Her garden is a delightful mix of whimsy and wildness.
sentences.zh: 她的花园是奇思妙想与自然野趣的怡人结合。

meaning.en: to make a long high sad sound, or to complain in an annoying way

sentences.en: The dog began to whine at night.
sentences.zh: 那只狗在夜里开始哀叫。

sentences.en: Stop whining about the weather and finish your work.
sentences.zh: 别抱怨天气了，把工作做完吧。

meaning.en: to hit someone or something with a whip

sentences.en: In the story they whip the tired horse.
sentences.zh: 故事中他们鞭打那匹疲惫的马。

sentences.en: During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.
sentences.zh: 在实操课上，烹饪专业学生学习打发奶油，并制作比市售甜点更健康的替代品。

meaning.en: a long thin piece of leather or rope with a handle, used for hitting

sentences.en: An old leather whip hung by the stable door.
sentences.zh: 马厩门旁挂着一根旧皮鞭。

meaning.en: to turn around very quickly

sentences.en: The leaves whirl in the wind.
sentences.zh: 树叶在风中急速旋转。

sentences.en: The dancers whirled across the stage, their skirts spinning like tops.
sentences.zh: 舞者们飞速旋转着穿过舞台，裙摆像陀螺一样转动。

meaning.en: a long, stiff hair growing near an animal's mouth

sentences.en: A tiny drop of milk hung from one whisker.
sentences.zh: 一滴小小的牛奶挂在一根胡须上。

sentences.en: Each whisker provides sensory information that helps some mammals navigate confined spaces and detect changes in their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 每根触须都能提供感官信息，帮助某些哺乳动物在狭窄空间中行动并察觉周围的变化。

meaning.en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and aged in barrels.

sentences.en: The guide showed us barrels used for ageing whisky.
sentences.zh: 导游向我们展示了用于陈酿威士忌的木桶。

sentences.en: Traditional whisky production attracts tourists to rural areas and supports employment in farming, manufacturing, and hospitality.
sentences.zh: 传统威士忌生产吸引游客前往乡村地区，并带动农业、制造业和酒店餐饮业的就业。

meaning.en: to speak very quietly, using breath rather than voice

sentences.en: Please whisper in the library.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆里请小声说话。

sentences.en: Students may whisper during individual tasks because they need reassurance rather than because they intend to disrupt lessons.
sentences.zh: 学生在独立完成任务时低声交谈，可能是为了寻求确认，而非有意扰乱课堂。

meaning.en: an object you blow into to make a high sound

sentences.en: The teacher blew a loud whistle.
sentences.zh: 老师吹了一声响亮的哨子。

sentences.en: Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.
sentences.zh: 岸边出现危险情况时，救生员用哨子迅速引起游泳者的注意。

meaning.en: to make a high sound by forcing air through your lips or a whistle

sentences.en: He whistled a happy tune while washing the dishes.
sentences.zh: 他洗碗时吹着欢快的小曲。

sentences.en: The referee whistled to stop the game after a serious foul.
sentences.zh: 严重犯规后，裁判鸣哨停止了比赛。

meaning.en: having the colour of snow or milk

sentences.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。

sentences.en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
sentences.zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

meaning.en: to hide faults or unpleasant facts and make something seem better

sentences.en: Do not whitewash the real problem.
sentences.zh: 不要粉饰真正的问题。

sentences.en: Independent investigations are essential to prevent organisations from attempting to whitewash serious failures in public safety.
sentences.zh: 独立调查对于防止机构试图掩盖公共安全方面的严重失误至关重要。

meaning.en: used to ask or talk about which person or people

sentences.en: Who is that man?
sentences.zh: 那个男人是谁？

sentences.en: She is the teacher who helped me most.
sentences.zh: 她是对我帮助最大的那位老师。

meaning.en: any person who, or no matter which person

sentences.en: Whoever finishes first can choose the next game.
sentences.zh: 谁先完成，谁就可以选择下一个游戏。

sentences.en: Public libraries should welcome whoever needs access to reliable information, regardless of their income or educational background.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆应欢迎任何需要获取可靠信息的人，不论其收入或教育背景如何。

meaning.en: all of something, not just a part

sentences.en: I eat the whole apple at lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午饭时吃了整个苹果。

sentences.en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
sentences.zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。

meaning.en: the sale of goods in large quantities, typically to retailers

sentences.en: They buy fruit at wholesale.
sentences.zh: 他们以批发方式购买水果。

sentences.en: The company specializes in the wholesale of electronic components.
sentences.zh: 这家公司专门从事电子元件的批发。

meaning.en: a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers

sentences.en: Our local wholesaler delivers fresh fruit to shops every morning.
sentences.zh: 我们当地的批发商每天早上给商店配送新鲜水果。

sentences.en: Small retailers often depend on a wholesaler to obtain goods at competitive prices.
sentences.zh: 小型零售商往往依靠批发商以有竞争力的价格采购商品。

meaning.zh: 有益健康的；有益身心的
meaning.en: good for your health or well-being; morally good and beneficial

sentences.en: Eating wholesome food helps you stay healthy.
sentences.zh: 吃有益健康的食物有助于你保持健康。

sentences.en: The school encourages wholesome activities such as sports and reading.
sentences.zh: 学校鼓励体育和阅读等有益身心的活动。

meaning.en: completely; entirely

sentences.en: She was wholly satisfied with the result.
sentences.zh: 她对结果完全满意。

sentences.en: The decision was wholly based on the evidence presented.
sentences.zh: 这个决定完全基于所提交的证据。

meaning.en: belonging to which person

sentences.en: Whose umbrella is this?
sentences.zh: 这是谁的雨伞？

sentences.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
sentences.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

meaning.en: for what reason

sentences.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
sentences.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

sentences.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
sentences.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

meaning.en: very bad or morally wrong

sentences.en: The wicked king was not kind.
sentences.zh: 那个邪恶的国王并不仁慈。

sentences.en: Traditional stories often contrast wicked characters with kind heroes to help children understand the consequences of moral choices.
sentences.zh: 传统故事常将邪恶角色与善良主人公作对比，帮助儿童理解道德选择的后果。

meaning.en: having a large distance from one side to the other

sentences.en: The river is wide after the rain.
sentences.zh: 雨后这条河变宽了。

sentences.en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
sentences.zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。

meaning.en: Across many places or among many people

sentences.en: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
sentences.zh: 这种水果在当地商店里随处可买到。

sentences.en: Although online learning is widely accepted, access to reliable internet connections still varies considerably between regions.
sentences.zh: 尽管在线学习已被广泛接受，各地区获得稳定网络连接的条件仍有很大差异。

meaning.en: to make or become wider

sentences.en: The city plans to widen the road.
sentences.zh: 市政府计划加宽这条道路。

sentences.en: Reading widely can widen your horizons.
sentences.zh: 广泛阅读可以开阔你的视野。

meaning.en: existing or happening over a large area or among many people

sentences.en: The flu became widespread across the whole country.
sentences.zh: 流感在全国范围内广泛传播。

sentences.en: There is widespread support for the new environmental policy.
sentences.zh: 这项新环境政策得到了广泛支持。

meaning.en: a woman whose husband has died

sentences.en: The widow lives alone in that house.
sentences.zh: 那位寡妇独自住在那栋房子里。

sentences.en: A widow living alone may benefit from community programmes that offer companionship and practical support.
sentences.zh: 独居的丧偶女性可能受益于提供陪伴和实际帮助的社区项目。

meaning.en: The measurement of something from side to side.

sentences.en: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
sentences.zh: 买沙发前先确认一下它的宽度。

sentences.en: Increasing the width of pavements can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make walking more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 加宽人行道可以方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让步行更舒适。

meaning.en: to hold and use a weapon, tool, or power

sentences.en: Judges wield great power in court.
sentences.zh: 法官在法庭上行使很大的权力。

sentences.en: The knight wielded a heavy sword in battle.
sentences.zh: 那位骑士在战斗中挥舞着一把重剑。

meaning.en: the woman a man is married to

sentences.en: His wife cooks dinner at home.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子在家做晚饭。

sentences.en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
sentences.zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。

meaning.zh: 无线网络；Wi-Fi（无线联网技术）
meaning.en: A technology that allows devices to connect to a network or the internet without cables.

sentences.en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
sentences.zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。

sentences.en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
sentences.zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。

meaning.en: a covering of artificial hair worn on the head

sentences.en: He wears a funny wig in the play.
sentences.zh: 他在剧中戴着一顶滑稽的假发。

sentences.en: The actor put on a white wig to look like an old judge.
sentences.zh: 那位演员戴上白色假发，让自己看起来像一位年老的法官。

meaning.en: living or growing in natural conditions, not kept or controlled by people

sentences.en: A wild rabbit eats grass.
sentences.zh: 一只野兔在吃草。

sentences.en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
sentences.zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。

meaning.en: an uninhabited, wild area of land

sentences.en: They camped in the wilderness far from town.
sentences.zh: 他们在远离城镇的荒野中露营。

sentences.en: The government has set aside a vast wilderness for wildlife conservation.
sentences.zh: 政府划出了一大片荒野用于野生动物保护。

meaning.en: a large fire that spreads quickly through a forest or countryside

sentences.en: The wildfire burned thousands of trees.
sentences.zh: 这场野火烧毁了成千上万棵树。

sentences.en: Dry weather and strong winds can cause a wildfire to spread rapidly.
sentences.zh: 干燥的天气和强风会使野火迅速蔓延。

meaning.en: animals and plants that live or grow in natural conditions, not kept or controlled by people

sentences.en: We watched wildlife in the forest.
sentences.zh: 我们在森林里观察野生动物。

sentences.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
sentences.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

meaning.en: used to talk about the future

sentences.en: I will call you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天会给你打电话。

sentences.en: By the time you arrive, we will have finished dinner.
sentences.zh: 等你到达时，我们将已经吃完晚饭了。

meaning.en: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want

sentences.en: She has a strong will and never gives up.
sentences.zh: 她有坚强的意志，从不放弃。

sentences.en: His will to succeed helped him overcome many difficulties.
sentences.zh: 他成功的决心帮助他克服了许多困难。

meaning.zh: 设法用意志力使（某事）发生；立遗嘱赠与
meaning.en: to try to make something happen by thinking about it very hard; to leave something to someone in a will

sentences.en: She willed herself to stay awake.
sentences.zh: 她努力让自己保持清醒。

sentences.en: He willed his entire fortune to charity.
sentences.zh: 他把全部财产遗赠给了慈善机构。

meaning.en: done deliberately, often in a stubborn or unreasonable way

sentences.en: It was a willful mistake, not an accident.
sentences.zh: 那是故意犯的错误，不是意外。

sentences.en: His willful refusal to follow the rules caused problems for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 他固执地拒绝遵守规则，给整个团队带来了麻烦。

meaning.en: ready and happy to do something

sentences.en: I am willing to help you move this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。

sentences.en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
sentences.zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。

meaning.en: By choice and without needing to be forced or persuaded.

sentences.en: She answered willingly during the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面试中欣然作答。

sentences.en: Residents are more likely to participate willingly in recycling schemes when collection services are convenient and reliable.
sentences.zh: 当回收服务便利且可靠时，居民更可能自愿参与回收计划。

meaning.en: The readiness to do something without needing to be forced.

sentences.en: Her willingness to help made the move much easier.
sentences.zh: 她乐意帮忙，让这次搬家轻松了许多。

sentences.en: Students' willingness to ask questions often increases when teachers create a supportive classroom environment.
sentences.zh: 教师营造支持性的课堂环境时，学生提问的意愿往往会增强。

meaning.en: a tree with long thin branches and narrow leaves, often growing near water

sentences.en: A willow grows by the river.
sentences.zh: 河边长着一棵柳树。

sentences.en: The willow's branches swayed gently in the wind.
sentences.zh: 柳树的枝条在风中轻轻摇曳。

meaning.en: to be first or best in a game, competition, or contest

sentences.en: Our team can win the game.
sentences.zh: 我们队能赢得这场比赛。

sentences.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
sentences.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

meaning.zh: （因疼痛或不适）皱眉、龇牙咧嘴；畏缩
meaning.en: to make a slight movement or expression of pain or discomfort

sentences.en: He did not wince when the nurse cleaned it.
sentences.zh: 护士清洗伤口时，他没有畏缩。

sentences.en: She winced as the cold wind hit her face.
sentences.zh: 冷风吹到脸上时，她皱起了眉头。

meaning.en: moving air that you can feel

sentences.en: The wind blew my hat away.
sentences.zh: 一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

sentences.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

meaning.en: a light jacket designed to protect the wearer from wind

sentences.en: Take a windbreaker with you; it can be windy by the lake.
sentences.zh: 带上防风夹克吧，湖边可能会刮风。

sentences.en: He zipped up his windbreaker and set off along the coastal path.
sentences.zh: 他拉上防风夹克的拉链，沿着海边小路出发了。

meaning.en: having a curving or twisting course

sentences.en: We drove along a winding road through the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的山路行驶。

sentences.en: The winding path led us to a quiet village.
sentences.zh: 那条曲折的小路把我们带到了一个安静的村庄。

meaning.en: a building with large blades turned by wind to make power or grind grain

sentences.en: The old windmill turns in the strong wind.
sentences.zh: 那座古老的风车在强风中转动。

sentences.en: Restoring a traditional windmill can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in the history of rural technology.
sentences.zh: 修复传统风车既能保护当地遗产，也能吸引对乡村技术史感兴趣的游客。

meaning.en: an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light and air

sentences.en: Open the window for fresh air.
sentences.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

sentences.en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
sentences.zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。

meaning.en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.

sentences.en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
sentences.zh: 一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。

sentences.en: A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
sentences.zh: 受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。

meaning.en: the sport of riding on water on a board with a sail

sentences.en: My sister tried windsurfing during our holiday by the lake.
sentences.zh: 我们在湖边度假时，我姐姐尝试了帆板运动。

sentences.en: Windsurfing schools can attract visitors to coastal towns, provided that local authorities establish clear water safety guidelines.
sentences.zh: 只要地方政府制定明确的水上安全准则，帆板学校就能吸引游客前往沿海城镇。

meaning.en: with a lot of wind

sentences.en: It is too windy to eat lunch outside today.
sentences.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

sentences.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
sentences.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

meaning.en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes

sentences.en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
sentences.zh: 这家餐馆在这款蘑菇酱里加了少量葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.
sentences.zh: 气候变化正在影响葡萄酒生产，因为气温上升改变了葡萄品质和采收时间。

meaning.en: one of the parts that a bird, insect, or bat uses for flying

sentences.en: The bird flaps its left wing.
sentences.zh: 那只鸟拍动左翅。

sentences.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
sentences.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

meaning.en: a part of a building that extends from the main part

sentences.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
sentences.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

meaning.en: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal

sentences.en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 姐姐隔着餐桌朝我眨了一只眼。

sentences.en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
sentences.zh: 友善的眨眼可能传达彼此的默契，但其含义在不同文化间可能有很大差异。

meaning.en: a person or team that wins a game, competition, or prize

sentences.en: The winner lifted the trophy while the crowd cheered.
sentences.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

sentences.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
sentences.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

meaning.en: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring

sentences.en: We make a snowman in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天我们会堆雪人。

sentences.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
sentences.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

meaning.en: to rub a surface to remove dirt or liquid from it

sentences.en: Please wipe the table after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后请擦一下桌子。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage pupils to wipe shared equipment after use to help maintain a hygienic learning environment.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在使用共用设备后进行擦拭，以帮助保持卫生的学习环境。

meaning.en: a thin, flexible thread of metal

sentences.en: The lamp needs a new wire.
sentences.zh: 这盏灯需要一根新电线。

sentences.en: Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.
sentences.zh: 老建筑往往需要更换电线，以符合现代安全标准并满足增长的用电需求。

meaning.en: the ability to use experience and knowledge to make good judgments

sentences.en: Grandparents share wisdom with children.
sentences.zh: 祖父母与孩子们分享智慧。

sentences.en: The wisdom of expanding road networks is increasingly questioned as cities seek more sustainable transport solutions.
sentences.zh: 随着城市寻求更可持续的交通方案，扩建道路网络是否明智越来越受到质疑。

meaning.en: able to make good judgments based on experience and knowledge

sentences.en: A wise person thinks before speaking.
sentences.zh: 有智慧的人说话前会先思考。

sentences.en: It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
sentences.zh: 政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。

meaning.en: to hope for something you want

sentences.en: I wish for a new book.
sentences.zh: 我希望得到一本新书。

sentences.en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
sentences.zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。

meaning.zh: 一厢情愿的；基于愿望而非事实的
meaning.en: based on wishes rather than facts; showing a desire for something that is unlikely to happen

sentences.en: It was wishful thinking to believe he would change.
sentences.zh: 认为他会改变只是一厢情愿的想法。

sentences.en: Her wishful hope that the project would finish early soon faded.
sentences.zh: 她希望项目早日完成的一厢情愿很快破灭了。

meaning.en: sad and full of longing, especially about something in the past

sentences.en: She gave a wistful smile.
sentences.zh: 她露出一个惆怅的微笑。

sentences.en: He grew wistful as he looked at old photos of his childhood.
sentences.zh: 看着童年的旧照片，他变得怀念起来。

meaning.en: the ability to say or write things that are clever and amusing

sentences.en: She is known for her wit and humor.
sentences.zh: 她以风趣幽默而闻名。

sentences.en: His speech was full of wit, keeping the audience entertained throughout.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲充满机智，让观众全程兴致盎然。

meaning.en: a woman who is believed to have magic powers, especially in stories

sentences.en: The witch flies on a broom in the story.
sentences.zh: 故事里的女巫骑着扫帚飞行。

sentences.en: In the old tale, the witch cast a spell on the village.
sentences.zh: 在那个古老的故事中，女巫对村庄施了魔法。

meaning.en: together with; accompanied by

sentences.en: I made dinner with my sister last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。

sentences.en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
sentences.zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。

meaning.zh: 取（款）；从银行账户中取出（钱）
meaning.en: to take money out of a bank account

sentences.en: I need to withdraw some money from the bank before the market closes.
sentences.zh: 我需要在市场关门前从银行取些钱。

sentences.en: You can withdraw cash from any ATM in the city.
sentences.zh: 你可以在城里任何一台自动取款机上取现金。

meaning.en: to remove or take back something, or to leave a place or activity

sentences.en: The company decided to withdraw its support for the project.
sentences.zh: 公司决定撤回对该项目的支持。

sentences.en: Several countries threatened to withdraw from the agreement if their concerns were not addressed.
sentences.zh: 如果它们的关切得不到解决，几个国家威胁要退出该协议。

meaning.en: to become dry and die, or to gradually become weaker and less successful

sentences.en: Flowers wither without water and light.
sentences.zh: 这些花一周没浇水，都枯萎了。

sentences.en: Without sustained investment, local industries may wither, leaving young people with few employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 没有持续投资，当地产业可能衰退，导致年轻人就业机会寥寥。

meaning.en: to refuse to give something to someone

sentences.en: They may withhold the payment.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会扣留这笔款项。

sentences.en: The company was accused of withholding important information from the public.
sentences.zh: 该公司被指控向公众隐瞒重要信息。

meaning.en: inside the limits of a particular area, time, or range

sentences.en: Please stay within the school yard.
sentences.zh: 你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。

sentences.en: Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
sentences.zh: 地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。

meaning.en: not having something

sentences.en: I cannot draw without a pencil.
sentences.zh: 没有铅笔我画不了画。

sentences.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
sentences.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

meaning.en: to be strong enough not to be damaged or affected by something

sentences.en: The wall can withstand strong wind.
sentences.zh: 这堵墙能经受住强风。

sentences.en: Coastal infrastructure must be designed to withstand stronger storms as climate change increases the frequency of extreme weather.
sentences.zh: 随着气候变化使极端天气更加频繁，沿海基础设施的设计必须能抵御更强的风暴。

meaning.en: a person who sees an event, typically a crime or accident, take place

sentences.en: A witness saw the car accident.
sentences.zh: 一名目击者看到了那起车祸。

sentences.en: The witness was asked to describe the suspect in detail.
sentences.zh: 证人被要求详细描述嫌疑人的外貌。

meaning.en: amusing in a clever way

sentences.en: Her witty reply made the whole class laugh.
sentences.zh: 她机智风趣的回答逗得全班都笑了。

sentences.en: A witty presentation can engage students, provided that humour supports rather than distracts from the lesson.
sentences.zh: 风趣的讲解可以吸引学生，但幽默应辅助教学，而不是分散学生的注意力。

meaning.en: a man in stories who has magic powers

sentences.en: The wizard makes a light in the dark.
sentences.zh: 巫师在黑暗中变出一盏灯。

sentences.en: In the story, a wise wizard helps the young hero on his journey.
sentences.zh: 在故事中，一位智慧的巫师帮助年轻英雄踏上旅程。

meaning.en: to move from side to side in an unsteady way

sentences.en: The table began to wobble.
sentences.zh: 桌子开始摇晃。

sentences.en: She wobbled on her high heels as she crossed the stage.
sentences.zh: 她穿着高跟鞋走过舞台时摇摇晃晃。

meaning.en: great sadness or misfortune

sentences.en: The letter brought more woe.
sentences.zh: 这封信带来了更多悲痛。

sentences.en: The family suffered years of woe after the accident.
sentences.zh: 事故发生后，这家人多年饱受痛苦。

meaning.en: a wild animal that looks like a dog and lives in groups

sentences.en: A wolf stood quietly at the edge of the forest.
sentences.zh: 一只狼静静地站在森林边缘。

sentences.en: Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.
sentences.zh: 保护狼群有助于控制森林栖息地中的鹿群数量，从而恢复生态平衡。

meaning.en: an adult female human being

sentences.en: The woman reads to her child.
sentences.zh: 那位女士给她的孩子读书。

sentences.en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
sentences.zh: 确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。

meaning.en: Plural of woman; more than one adult female person.

sentences.en: Three women were planting flowers in the shared garden.
sentences.zh: 三位女性正在公共花园里种花。

sentences.en: Equal access to education enables more women to pursue careers in science and technology.
sentences.zh: 平等的受教育机会使更多女性能够从事科技领域的职业。

meaning.en: to want to know something or feel curious about it

sentences.en: I wonder where my book is.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我的书在哪里。

sentences.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
sentences.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

meaning.en: extremely good; enjoyable or impressive

sentences.en: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

sentences.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

meaning.en: to try to win someone's love or support

sentences.en: He tried to woo the voters.
sentences.zh: 他试图争取选民的支持。

sentences.en: The company is trying to woo young customers with new products.
sentences.zh: 这家公司正试图用新产品吸引年轻顾客。

meaning.en: the hard material that trees are made of

sentences.en: Dad makes a box from wood.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用木头做了一个盒子。

sentences.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
sentences.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

meaning.zh: 树木覆盖的；林木茂密的
meaning.en: covered with trees

sentences.en: They walked through a wooded hill.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过一座林木茂密的小山。

sentences.en: The house is surrounded by wooded countryside.
sentences.zh: 这座房子被树木繁茂的乡村环绕。

meaning.en: made of wood

sentences.en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
sentences.zh: 她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。

sentences.en: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
sentences.zh: 如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。

meaning.en: a bird with a strong beak that makes holes in trees to find insects

sentences.en: A woodpecker was tapping on the tree.
sentences.zh: 一只啄木鸟在树上啄洞。

sentences.en: The woodpecker's loud drumming echoed through the forest.
sentences.zh: 啄木鸟响亮的啄木声在森林中回荡。

meaning.en: The edge of a wood or the land beside it.

sentences.en: We rested at the woodside, just beyond the meadow.
sentences.zh: 我们穿过草地后，在林边休息。

sentences.en: Preserving vegetation along the woodside can provide shelter for wildlife moving between forests and open farmland.
sentences.zh: 保留林边植被可以为在森林与开阔农田之间活动的野生动物提供庇护。

meaning.en: the hair that covers the body of sheep

sentences.en: This warm coat is made of wool.
sentences.zh: 这件暖和的外套是羊毛做的。

sentences.en: Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
sentences.zh: 羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。

meaning.en: made of wool

sentences.en: She wore a warm woolen sweater.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件暖和的羊毛衫。

sentences.en: The woolen fabric is soft and breathable, making it ideal for winter clothing.
sentences.zh: 这种羊毛面料柔软透气，非常适合做冬装。

meaning.en: made of wool

sentences.en: She wore a thick woollen sweater on the cold morning.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的早晨，她穿了一件厚厚的羊毛衫。

sentences.en: Although woollen clothing provides excellent insulation, its environmental impact depends partly on farming practices and manufacturing methods.
sentences.zh: 虽然羊毛衣物保暖性能优良，但其环境影响部分取决于养殖方式和制造方法。

meaning.en: woollen cloth or garments

sentences.en: This shop sells woollens and other winter clothing.
sentences.zh: 这家店出售毛织品和其他冬装。

meaning.en: a unit of language that has a meaning and can be spoken or written

sentences.en: This word is new to me.
sentences.zh: 这个词对我来说是新的。

sentences.en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
sentences.zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。

meaning.en: The particular words chosen to express something.

sentences.en: The wording of your message sounds a little formal.
sentences.zh: 你这条消息的措辞听起来有点正式。

sentences.en: Careful wording in public health announcements can prevent confusion and encourage people to follow advice.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生公告采用严谨的措辞，可以避免误解并鼓励人们遵循建议。

meaning.en: Using more words than are needed to express something.

sentences.en: His wordy email made a simple request sound complicated.
sentences.zh: 他那封啰唆的邮件把一个简单请求说得很复杂。

sentences.en: Public information should be clear, as wordy explanations can prevent readers from understanding essential advice.
sentences.zh: 公共信息应清晰明了，因为冗长的解释可能妨碍读者理解重要建议。

meaning.en: to do a job, especially to earn money

sentences.en: Dad and Mum work in the city.
sentences.zh: 爸爸和妈妈在城里工作。

sentences.en: She works hard to support her family.
sentences.zh: 她努力工作养家。

meaning.en: to think of or solve something; to calculate; to exercise

sentences.en: They work out after class.
sentences.zh: 他们课后锻炼。

sentences.en: We need to work out a plan to reduce costs.
sentences.zh: 我们需要制定一个降低成本计划。

meaning.en: Someone who works excessively and finds it hard to stop

sentences.en: My brother is a workaholic who rarely takes holidays.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥是个工作狂，几乎不休假。

sentences.en: A workaholic may achieve short-term career success while neglecting personal relationships and long-term health.
sentences.zh: 工作狂可能取得短期的职业成功，却忽视了人际关系和长期健康。

meaning.en: A book containing exercises for learners to complete

sentences.en: I left my workbook in my school bag.
sentences.zh: 我把练习册落在书包里了。

sentences.en: A well-designed workbook allows students to practise new skills independently and monitor their progress.
sentences.zh: 一本设计合理的练习册能让学生独立练习新技能，并跟踪自己的进步。

meaning.zh: 工作日（通常指周一到周五）
meaning.en: a day on which you usually work, especially a weekday

sentences.en: Monday is a workday for most people.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，星期一是工作日。

sentences.en: She tries to finish all her emails before the workday ends.
sentences.zh: 她尽量在工作日结束前处理完所有邮件。

meaning.en: a person who works, especially one who does a particular job

sentences.en: A worker in an orange uniform repaired the broken fence.
sentences.zh: 一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。

sentences.en: Employers should provide every worker with appropriate training and equipment to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
sentences.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当的培训和设备，以降低工伤风险。

meaning.en: all the people who work in a company, industry, or country

sentences.en: The company has a workforce of about 500 people.
sentences.zh: 这家公司大约有500名员工。

sentences.en: New technology is changing the skills that the workforce needs.
sentences.zh: 新技术正在改变劳动力所需的技能。

meaning.zh: 工作的；工作上的；有工作的
meaning.en: relating to work or having a job

sentences.en: She has a working lunch with her manager every Monday.
sentences.zh: 她每周一都和经理一起吃工作午餐。

sentences.en: The new policy aims to improve working conditions for factory employees.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策旨在改善工厂员工的工作条件。

meaning.en: The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.

sentences.en: My workload doubled when two colleagues went on holiday.
sentences.zh: 两位同事休假后，我的工作量增加了一倍。

sentences.en: Employers should monitor staff workload carefully to prevent stress and maintain the quality of their services.
sentences.zh: 雇主应密切关注员工的工作量，以预防压力并维持服务质量。

meaning.zh: 工人，工匠（尤指体力劳动者）
meaning.en: a person who does manual work, especially in construction or industry

sentences.en: The workman repaired the roof quickly.
sentences.zh: 那个工人很快修好了屋顶。

sentences.en: A skilled workman can earn a good wage in this city.
sentences.zh: 熟练工人在这个城市能挣到不错的工资。

meaning.en: The skill and quality shown in making something.

sentences.en: The smooth wooden joints reveal the chair's excellent workmanship.
sentences.zh: 平滑的木质接合处体现了这把椅子精良的做工。

sentences.en: Consumers may accept higher prices when products demonstrate superior workmanship and offer a longer useful life.
sentences.zh: 如果产品做工更精良、使用寿命更长，消费者可能会接受更高的价格。

meaning.en: a person you work with

sentences.en: My workmate helped me finish the report.
sentences.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

sentences.en: She gets along well with her workmates and often has lunch with them.
sentences.zh: 她和同事们相处得很好，经常和他们一起吃午饭。

meaning.en: a period of physical exercise

sentences.en: His morning workout lasts thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 他早上的锻炼持续三十分钟。

sentences.en: A regular workout can improve physical health and help office workers manage stress more effectively.
sentences.zh: 定期锻炼可以改善身体健康，并帮助办公室职员更有效地缓解压力。

meaning.en: a piece of material being processed or shaped, especially in a machine

sentences.en: The worker clamped the workpiece firmly before drilling.
sentences.zh: 工人在钻孔前把工件牢牢夹紧。

sentences.en: Precision machining requires the workpiece to be aligned accurately on the machine table.
sentences.zh: 精密加工要求工件在机床工作台上准确对齐。
