meaning.en: The place where people do their jobs.

sentences.en: Our workplace has a quiet room for taking a nap at noon.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作场所有一间安静的房间，供午休使用。

sentences.en: Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 营造包容的工作环境有助于员工感到受重视，并促进不同背景的人之间的合作。

meaning.en: the works produced by an artist, writer, or composer

sentences.en: The museum displays the works of several famous artists.
sentences.zh: 博物馆展出了几位著名艺术家的作品。

sentences.en: Her early works were influenced by folk music.
sentences.zh: 她的早期作品受到民间音乐的影响。

meaning.en: a place with tools and machinery for making or repairing things; a practical class or session where people learn and share skills

sentences.en: Tools hang on the workshop wall.
sentences.zh: 工具挂在车间的墙上。

sentences.en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
sentences.zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。

meaning.zh: 世界；地球及其上所有人
meaning.en: the Earth and all the people on it

sentences.en: The world has many countries.
sentences.zh: 世界上有许多国家。

sentences.en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
sentences.zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。

meaning.zh: 遍及全球的；世界范围的
meaning.en: existing or happening in all parts of the world

sentences.en: The company has a world-wide network of offices.
sentences.zh: 这家公司拥有遍及全球的办事处网络。

sentences.en: The news of the discovery spread world-wide within hours.
sentences.zh: 这一发现的消息在几小时内就传遍了全世界。

meaning.zh: 世俗的；尘世的；关注物质世界的
meaning.en: connected with the physical world and ordinary life rather than with spiritual or religious matters

sentences.en: He gave up worldly pleasures and became a monk.
sentences.zh: 他放弃了世俗的享乐，出家做了和尚。

sentences.en: Her worldly success did not bring her the happiness she had expected.
sentences.zh: 她在世俗意义上的成功并没有给她带来预期的幸福。

meaning.en: existing or happening in all parts of the world

sentences.en: The song became worldwide last year.
sentences.zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。

sentences.en: Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。

meaning.en: in or across all parts of the world
a long, soft animal with no bones, arms, or legs

sentences.en: A worm lives under the soil.
sentences.zh: 一条蠕虫生活在土壤下面。

sentences.en: Worms improve soil quality by breaking down organic matter and allowing air to circulate underground.
sentences.zh: 蚯蚓通过分解有机物并使空气在地下流通来改善土壤质量。

meaning.en: damaged or made thin by long use

sentences.en: He put on a pair of worn shoes.
sentences.zh: 他穿上了一双破旧的鞋。

sentences.en: The carpet was worn thin in places where people walked most.
sentences.zh: 地毯在人们走动最多的地方被磨薄了。

meaning.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

sentences.en: She looked worried when the cat didn't come back.
sentences.zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。

sentences.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
sentences.zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

meaning.en: to feel uneasy about something

sentences.en: Do not worry about the little test.
sentences.zh: 不要担心这个小测验。

sentences.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
sentences.zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

meaning.en: of poorer quality or in a more serious or unpleasant state than before

sentences.en: The rain is worse this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今天下午的雨更大了。

sentences.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
sentences.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

meaning.en: to make or become worse

sentences.en: Cold weather can worsen a bad cough.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的天气会使严重的咳嗽恶化。

sentences.en: The economic situation is likely to worsen if no action is taken.
sentences.zh: 如果不采取行动，经济形势可能会进一步恶化。

meaning.en: to show respect and love for God or a god, especially by praying or singing

sentences.en: They worship at the temple every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 他们每个星期天都在寺庙里敬拜。

sentences.en: Historic places of worship often serve as important centres of community life and cultural heritage.
sentences.zh: 历史悠久的宗教场所往往是社区生活与文化传承的重要中心。

meaning.en: worst or most severe in quality or condition

sentences.en: That was the worst meal I have ever had.
sentences.zh: 那是我吃过的最糟糕的一顿饭。

sentences.en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
sentences.zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

meaning.en: in the worst way or to the worst degree

sentences.en: He played worst in the final match.
sentences.zh: 他在决赛中表现得最差。

meaning.en: having a certain value or deserving something

sentences.en: This old book is worth a lot.
sentences.zh: 这本旧书值很多钱。

sentences.en: Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.
sentences.zh: 投资公共交通值得付出前期费用，因为这能减少拥堵和污染。

meaning.en: having no value or practical use

sentences.en: Without those parts, the old machine is worthless.
sentences.zh: 缺了那些零件，这台旧机器就毫无用处。

sentences.en: Digital skills can quickly become worthless if training focuses only on tools that are soon outdated.
sentences.zh: 如果培训只关注很快就会过时的工具，数字技能可能迅速失去价值。

meaning.en: worth the time, money, or effort spent on it

sentences.en: Helping at the shelter is a worthwhile job.
sentences.zh: 在收容所做志愿者是一项值得做的工作。

sentences.en: Although the project took months, the experience was worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 虽然这个项目花了几个月，但这段经历是值得的。

meaning.en: deserving something, especially attention, support, or reward

sentences.en: It was a worthy example in class.
sentences.zh: 你这个深思熟虑的建议值得认真考虑。

sentences.en: Community projects that improve access to education are worthy of sustained public investment.
sentences.zh: 改善教育机会的社区项目值得获得持续的公共投资。

meaning.zh: （表示过去将来）将会；（表示意愿）愿意；（表示推测）大概；（表示礼貌请求）请
meaning.en: used to talk about the past future, willingness, probability, or polite requests

sentences.en: She said she would come to the party.
sentences.zh: 她说她会来参加聚会。

sentences.en: Would you mind opening the window?
sentences.zh: 你介意打开窗户吗？

meaning.en: to like or want one thing more than another

sentences.en: I would prefer to stay at home tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我更愿意待在家里。

sentences.en: She would prefer a quiet dinner to a noisy party.
sentences.zh: 比起吵闹的聚会，她更愿意安静地吃顿饭。

meaning.en: an injury to the body, especially one made by a cut or tear in the skin

sentences.en: The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.
sentences.zh: 护士仔细清洗了伤口。

sentences.en: Access to clean water and basic medical supplies is essential for treating wounds and preventing infection.
sentences.zh: 获得清洁用水和基本医疗用品，对处理伤口和预防感染至关重要。

meaning.en: injured, especially by a weapon in a battle or attack

sentences.en: The wounded soldier was taken to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 那名受伤的士兵被送往医院。

sentences.en: The rescue team helped the wounded civilians after the attack.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，救援队帮助了受伤的平民。

meaning.en: people who have been injured, especially in a battle or attack

sentences.en: The hospital is treating the wounded from the accident.
sentences.zh: 医院正在救治事故中的伤员。

sentences.en: Volunteers brought food and water to the wounded.
sentences.zh: 志愿者给伤员送去了食物和水。

meaning.zh: 哇（表示惊叹、赞赏或兴奋）
meaning.en: used to express surprise, admiration, or excitement

sentences.en: Wow! That view is amazing!
sentences.zh: 哇！那景色太美了！

sentences.en: Wow, I didn't expect you to finish so quickly.
sentences.zh: 哇，我没想到你完成得这么快。

meaning.en: to impress or excite someone greatly

sentences.en: The magician's performance wowed the audience.
sentences.zh: 魔术师的表演让观众惊叹不已。

meaning.en: to argue angrily or noisily about something

sentences.en: The neighbors wrangle about the fence.
sentences.zh: 邻居们为栅栏争吵。

sentences.en: The two departments wrangled over the budget for weeks.
sentences.zh: 两个部门为预算争论了数周。

meaning.en: to cover something with paper or cloth

sentences.en: Wrap the gift with pretty paper.
sentences.zh: 用漂亮的纸把礼物包起来。

sentences.en: Retailers could reduce packaging waste by encouraging customers to wrap gifts in reusable fabric.
sentences.zh: 零售商可以鼓励顾客用可重复使用的布料包装礼物，以减少包装废弃物。

meaning.en: extreme anger

sentences.en: The king roared in wrath at them.
sentences.zh: 国王对他们怒吼，勃然大怒。

sentences.en: She feared her father's wrath more than any punishment.
sentences.zh: 她害怕父亲的暴怒，胜过害怕任何惩罚。

meaning.en: a ring of flowers or leaves, especially one used as a decoration or at a funeral

sentences.en: They placed a wreath on the grave.
sentences.zh: 他们在墓前放置了一个花圈。

sentences.en: Laying a wreath at a memorial allows communities to express shared grief and honour the past.
sentences.zh: 在纪念碑前敬献花圈，让社区成员能够表达共同的哀思并缅怀过去。

meaning.en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist

sentences.en: Thin wisps of steam wreathed her face above the bowl.
sentences.zh: 碗里升起的缕缕蒸汽缭绕在她脸庞周围。

sentences.en: Smoke from nearby factories can wreathe residential buildings, highlighting the need for stricter industrial emission controls.
sentences.zh: 附近工厂排出的烟雾可能笼罩住宅楼，凸显加强工业排放管控的必要性。

meaning.en: to destroy or badly damage something

sentences.en: Strong waves can wreck a small wooden boat.
sentences.zh: 巨浪可以毁坏一艘小木船。

sentences.en: Poorly planned construction can wreck historic neighbourhoods and permanently reduce their cultural value for future generations.
sentences.zh: 规划不当的建设会毁坏历史街区，并永久削弱其对后代的文化价值。

meaning.en: a tool for turning nuts and bolts

sentences.en: Turn the bolt with a wrench.
sentences.zh: 用扳手转动螺栓。

sentences.en: Leaving a close community can be a real wrench for students who move abroad for university.
sentences.zh: 对赴海外上大学的学生来说，离开关系紧密的社区可能十分难舍。

meaning.zh: 摔跤；搏斗；努力解决（难题）
meaning.en: to fight by holding and pushing someone, or to struggle hard to deal with a problem

sentences.en: The boys wrestle on the grass.
sentences.zh: 男孩们在草地上摔跤。

sentences.en: She had to wrestle with her conscience before making the decision.
sentences.zh: 在做决定之前，她不得不与自己的良心作斗争。

meaning.zh: 悲惨的；恶劣的；质量极差的
meaning.en: very unhappy, or of very poor quality or conditions

sentences.en: They lived in a wretched house.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一所破败不堪的房子里。

sentences.en: Families living in wretched housing conditions face greater risks of respiratory illness and other health problems.
sentences.zh: 居住条件恶劣的家庭面临更高的呼吸系统疾病及其他健康问题风险。

meaning.en: to twist and turn the body with quick short movements

sentences.en: The fish began to wriggle on the hook.
sentences.zh: 鱼开始在钩子上扭动。

sentences.en: She managed to wriggle out of the tight dress.
sentences.zh: 她设法扭动着从那条紧身裙里脱了出来。

meaning.en: to twist and squeeze something, especially to remove liquid

sentences.en: Wring the wet cloth before you hang it.
sentences.zh: 把湿毛巾拧干后再挂起来。

sentences.en: Where washing machines are unavailable, residents must wring out heavy clothes by hand after washing.
sentences.zh: 在没有洗衣机的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物后必须用手拧干。

meaning.en: a small line or fold in the skin, especially one caused by aging

sentences.en: A wrinkle appeared near her eye.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛附近出现了一条皱纹。

sentences.en: He noticed a deep wrinkle on his forehead after years of frowning.
sentences.zh: 多年皱眉之后，他注意到额头上有一道深深的皱纹。

meaning.en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.

sentences.en: She wears a silver bracelet on her wrist.
sentences.zh: 她的手腕上戴着一条银手链。

sentences.en: Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.
sentences.zh: 办公室员工应调整键盘位置，减轻长时间使用电脑时手腕承受的压力。

meaning.en: a formal legal document ordering someone to do or stop doing something

sentences.en: The court issued a writ.
sentences.zh: 法院签发了一份令状。

sentences.en: The company was served with a writ for breach of contract.
sentences.zh: 该公司因违约而收到了一份令状。

meaning.en: to make words or letters with a pen or pencil, or to create text

sentences.en: I write a letter to Grandma.
sentences.zh: 我给奶奶写一封信。

sentences.en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
sentences.zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。

meaning.en: to write something on paper so that you can remember it

sentences.en: Please write down your name and address.
sentences.zh: 请写下你的姓名和地址。

sentences.en: She wrote down the main points of the lecture in her notebook.
sentences.zh: 她把讲座的要点记在了笔记本上。

meaning.en: a person who writes books, articles, etc.

sentences.en: She is a famous writer.
sentences.zh: 她是一位著名的作家。

sentences.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
sentences.zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

meaning.en: to twist and turn the body, especially because of pain or discomfort

sentences.en: The injured man began to writhe in pain.
sentences.zh: 受伤的男子开始痛苦地扭动身体。

sentences.en: She writhed on the floor, clutching her stomach.
sentences.zh: 她捂着肚子在地上翻滚。

meaning.en: the activity or skill of writing; written works

sentences.en: Students study the word writing in this book.
sentences.zh: 我的写作大多在早餐前完成。

sentences.en: Regular writing practice helps students organise complex ideas and communicate their arguments more clearly.
sentences.zh: 经常练习写作有助于学生组织复杂的想法，并更清楚地表达论点。

meaning.en: Expressed in writing rather than speech.

sentences.en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
sentences.zh: 请把书面说明发来，方便我照着做。

sentences.en: Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.
sentences.zh: 书面反馈让学生能够回顾错误，并逐步提高表现。

meaning.zh: write 的过去分词：写下的；已写的
meaning.en: Past participle of write; having been written.

sentences.en: She has written three letters this morning.
sentences.zh: 她今天上午已经写了三封信。

sentences.en: The novel was written in only six months and became an instant success.
sentences.zh: 这部小说仅用六个月就写成了，并一举成功。

meaning.en: not correct; mistaken

sentences.en: This answer is wrong.
sentences.zh: 这个答案是错误的。

sentences.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

meaning.en: showing dry, mocking, or bitter humor

sentences.en: He gave a wry smile.
sentences.zh: 他苦笑了一下。

sentences.en: She made a wry comment about the absurdity of the situation.
sentences.zh: 她对这种荒唐的局面作了句带讽刺意味的评论。
